name: computer_key
description: Press a key or shortcut, such as "Return", "Escape", "Tab", or a chord like "cmd+l" on macOS and "ctrl+l" on Windows. Combine modifiers with "+" (cmd, ctrl, alt, shift). Returns a screenshot taken after the key press. With an app target the result is text only; observe again before the next action.

target.description: Default: {"scope":"app","pid":…,"target_id":…} from computer_apps or computer_resolve_app. That drives one macOS app without taking screen control or moving the real cursor (a cursor overlay is still shown), and needs no computer_start_control. Omit (or {"scope":"screen"}) only to escalate to full-display remote control.
